Commemorating the Jihad Resolution at the Historic NU Building in Surabaya 
 HARI SANTRI 2026 Commemorating the Jihad Resolution at the Historic NU Building in Surabaya
 The historic NU building in Surabaya hosted the mujahadah kubro activity which was part of the commemoration of National Santri Day.
 22 Okt 2026 14:51 WIB · Politik & Hukum 
 Kompas/Bahana Patria Gupta
 Kecil Sedang Besar Sangat Besar Share
 Copy Link
 By Ambrosius Harto 
 This article has been translated using AI. See original . 
 00:00 00:00 10 10 1.00x The Secretariat Building of the Nahdlatul Ulama Branch Management in Surabaya, East Java, became the center of the grand mujahadah for the commemoration of Santri Day, Thursday (22/10/2026) evening.
 This secretariat during the Dutch East Indies colonial period was called the Hoofdbestuur Nahdlatoel Oelama (HBNO). HBNO is the central office of Nahdlatul Ulama (NU), an Islamic social organization established on January 31, 1926, in Surabaya.
 In this building, on October 22, 1945, the Jihad Resolution was declared, which is now commemorated as Santri Day. This year, this cultural heritage building at the corner of Jalan Bubutan VI and Jalan Pahlawan was chosen as the location for the Great Mujahadah for Humanity and Palestine.
 According to the Chairman of the Surabaya City PCNU, KH Masduki Thoha, the mujahadah kubro will be held on Thursday night. This event will include prayers, dhikr, istighasah, salawat, and the reading of the Jihad Resolution. The mujahadah kubro is part of a series of activities commemorating Santri Day, as established by the Central Board of NU in Jakarta.
 Masduki stated that the implementation of the mujahadah kubro will close the western side of Jalan Pahlawan. This event is held in light of the historical contributions of NU to Indonesia's journey. As the former headquarters and the location of the Jihad Resolution declaration, the choice of this secretariat is considered appropriate.
 The Jihad Resolution was declared in relation to the nation's determination to uphold the Proclamation of Indonesian Independence on August 17, 1945. A week after the Jihad Resolution, a series of armed confrontations erupted between Indonesia and the allied forces, which later became known as the Battle of Surabaya. This incident is commemorated as Heroes' Day every November 10.
 The Jihad Resolution and the Battle of Surabaya demonstrated a nation's determination to live independently from colonial rule. This spirit, Masduki said, remains relevant in national and state life.
 Meanwhile, the themes of humanity and Palestine signify Indonesia's steadfastness in constitutional principles. The preamble of the 1945 Constitution states that independence is the right of all nations and that colonialism must be abolished as it is incompatible with humanity and justice.
 "Jihad Resolution reminds us of the role of scholars and students in the nation's struggle to respect and uphold humanity," said Masduki. These values and principles will remain relevant for the advancement and progress of community life. Here, scholars and students need to continue to contribute.
 In Jombang Regency, the Santri Day commemoration was held at Tebuireng Islamic Boarding School. The commemoration took place with a ceremony. Following that, a procession was held to carry the Jihad Resolution manuscript to Surabaya.
 To escort the procession, the Jombang Regency Nahdlatul Ulama Executive Board (PCNU) assigned the Multipurpose Ansor Brigade (Banser). The escort was carried out by 99 motorcycles.
 According to the Chairman of the PCNU Jombang Regency, KH Fahmi Amrullah Hadzig, the procession carried the Jihad Resolution text to then join the participants of the mujahadah kubro in Surabaya.
 "Santri Day cannot be separated from the events of the Jihad Resolution," said Gus Fahmi, one of the grandsons of the founder and Rais Akbar of NU KH Hasyim Asy'ari.
 The Jihad Resolution reminds us of the role of ulama and santri in the nation's struggle to respect and uphold humanity.
